claim: Census QuickFacts supports Morton village city context, including the report's explicitly vintaged 2024 population estimate and the displayed 2020-2024 age shares, income, density, and commute facts.

retrieval.method: Direct public web fetch of Census QuickFacts plus a search of the indexed official Census QuickFacts V2024 result for the retained historical estimate.

result: The live QuickFacts page now defaults to the newer July 1, 2025 estimate of 17,565. It still confirms 25.9% under 18, 23.1% age 65+, $94,402 median household income, 1,336.4 people per square mile, and a 16.6-minute commute. An indexed official Census QuickFacts V2024 result confirms 17,557 for July 1, 2024. The report labels that number as a 2024 city estimate, so the vintage difference does not contradict the report.
limitations: The live endpoint is mutable and no frozen Census payload is stored in the packet. The 2024 estimate is historical rather than the current default. All values are city-boundary context, not drive-time catchment measurements.
